name: Amplitude Audio SDK
listed_description: A cross-platform audio engine designed with the needs of games in mind.
reason: README (opened) has no performance claim or numbers. No published benchmark against FMOD or Wwise found (WebSearch returned only Wwise/FMOD profiling guidance and nothing on Amplitude).

name: assimp
listed_description: Open Asset Import Library (assimp) is a cross-platform 3D model import library which aims to provide a common API for different 3D asset file formats.
reason: Readme.md (opened) has no speed claim. Third-party comparison (Aras Pranckevicius, .obj parse libraries, 2022; page blocked here, snippet only) says assimp is not fast by design (its site says it is not designed for speed) and slower than tinyobjloader, fast_obj and rapidobj. Rapidobj docs/BENCHMARKS.md (opened) has no assimp row. It is a slow baseline, not a faster alternative.

name: AudioFile
listed_description: A simple C++ library for reading and writing audio files.
reason: Directional only: release note 1.0.9 says 'Faster loading of audio files' with no numbers and no named baseline. No README benchmark; the two speed-matching issues (#93, #54) are about resampling. No third-party WAV loading shootout found that includes it.

name: avcpp
reason: Wrapper around the FFmpeg C API. README and repo tree (opened) have no performance claim, no benchmark directory and no numbers; its goal is API convenience, not speed.

name: bgfx
reason: README, docs/overview.rst and docs/internals.rst (opened) describe sort-based draw call bucketing and multithreaded encoders but give no comparison numbers against a named baseline. WebSearch (two queries) found no bgfx benchmark against native OpenGL, Vulkan or other renderers.

name: bitmap
listed_description: C++ Bitmap Library for reading, writing, and processing BMP image files.
reason: Only claim is that the resizing routines are 'Highly optimized' (repo page, opened), with no numbers and no named baseline. The default-branch README.md and readme.txt paths on raw.githubusercontent.com returned 404; the readme.md on the repo page was read through WebFetch. No third-party benchmark found.
